I fixed the regex and made the invocation print EXTRACT-FAILED and exit 99 on any extraction failure; all evidence 02-14 and 24 were regenerated with the fixed invocation and outputs for V1-V8, V10-V12 were byte-identical to the first run (01 is the pre-write run with the original extractor, which matched V12 correctly).

EXIT markers: for blocks that end in an echo trailer (V1, V2, V4, V7, V8, V12 family) the EXIT line is the status of the final echo (0) and so is not informative alone; the real inner statuses are in the output (exit=, scope_guard_exit=) and independently confirmed by the untailed direct runs (files 17, 22, 23).
